title: Healthcare Graph Anatomy Explorer
description: Given a rendered labeled property graph, the learner can identify which visual elements are nodes and which are edges, and state the label and properties of each.
creator: Modeling Healthcare Data with Graphs
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Modeling Healthcare Data with Graphs

learningObjectives: Given a rendered labeled property graph, the learner can identify which visual elements are nodes and which are edges, and state the label and properties of each.

pedagogical.rationale: The Understand-level verbs identify and classify require visible labels and concrete property values. Learners control disclosure; continuous animation is unnecessary.
pedagogical.assessment: Explain why Patient is a label, patient_id is a property key, and MRN-48213 is a property value. Identify the source and destination of WORKS_AT.
